services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Enjoy a day on the water with us! All private boat tours hold up to 6 people About This is a perfect Key West boat tour to get out on the waters of Key West and do multiple activities. Instead of having to choose one type of activity (fishing, snorkeling, dolphin watching, sandbar tours, lobstering, or a sunset tour) we allow you to create a key west water activities package so you can do exactly what you want, without having to rush due to time restrictions. We want to give you and your family an experience to remember for a lifetime. Choose any activities while we are out on the water. With All Ages Welcome! • Up to 8 Hours! • Up to 6 people

services.name: Key West private sandbar tour
services.desc: Enjoy a Key West private sandbar tour! All private boat tours hold up to 6 people Let's Go! With this trip you, your family, and friends will enjoy a cruise to one of Key West's sandbars. We will relax in the sun at the sandbar swimming, walking, and exploring. Feel free to bring any food or drinks. We will have plenty of ice and cooler space on the boat. About Your Captain Eric Grandcourt’s life started in Broomfield, Colorado many moons ago. services.name: The Dry Tortugas
services.desc: 10 Hours About Enjoy a day on the water exploring from Key West all the way to the Dry Tortugas. This will be a Nice day trip enjoying the Historic Fort Jefferson located on Garden Key. We will enjoy a nice lunch and exploring the entire park which you can only get on a private boat. Since we will have limited time out at the park you can choose one of two additional activities while we are out in the park. Snorkeling or fishing but not enough time to effectively do both.
